responsibility: Implements the Rust backend’s registry of GCC built-in functions and the mapping from Rust intrinsic names to callable GCC TREE decls. It initializes math, overflow, atomic, and selected utility builtins, creates their GCC function types and declarations with the right attributes, records both builtin and library spellings, and provides lookup helpers used later when intrinsic lowering needs an existing GCC builtin entry point.
same_name_distinction: Defines and registers the builtin inventory itself: it constructs GCC builtin decls and function types, populates the builtin maps, and performs the setup for math, overflow, atomic, and utility builtins. Unlike the header, this is the implementation that materializes the registry contents rather than just declaring the BuiltinsContext interface and stored maps.
